paths.title: Frontend Developer
paths.description: From semantic markup to production React apps with Redux state and server rendering.
paths.outcome: Build and ship modern web front ends.

paths.title: Full-Stack Developer
paths.description: JavaScript, TypeScript and React on the front end, Next.js on the server, MySQL for data.
paths.outcome: Own a feature end to end, from UI to database.

paths.title: Backend Developer
paths.description: JavaScript and TypeScript fundamentals, then Node.js and Express to build APIs, with MySQL for data.
paths.outcome: Design, build and ship production REST APIs.

paths.title: Mobile App Developer
paths.description: Use your React and Redux skills to build iOS and Android apps.
paths.outcome: Ship cross-platform mobile apps with React Native.

paths.title: Angular Developer
paths.description: The web fundamentals and TypeScript, then Angular for enterprise-scale applications.

paths.title: Backend & Data Foundations
paths.description: Python for scripting and APIs, MySQL for storing and querying data.
paths.outcome: Write backend services and work confidently with data.

paths.title: AI-Ready Professional
paths.description: Get dependable results from AI tools, then automate with Python.
paths.outcome: Use AI safely and productively in everyday work.

paths.title: Coding Interview Prep
paths.description: Solid JavaScript, then data structures, algorithms and the problem-solving patterns interviewers test.
paths.outcome: Solve unseen coding problems confidently in technical interviews.

paths.title: Server & DevOps Foundations
paths.description: Linux and the command line first, then Node.js and MySQL on servers you set up and secure yourself.
paths.outcome: Deploy, secure and troubleshoot backend apps on Linux servers.
